RECORD BNA: 365 M EN 177:25 HRS, 1.08 MPH, ULT.3.MTS: 85-68-22.
RHINO: 330 M EN 156:02 HRS.

Hrs Feb-02-2015
00:00 - 03:00 3.00 WITH 10 5/8" BIT AT 5,740 M, CIRCULATED WELL UNTIL CLEAN RETURNS 130 SPM, 500 GPM, 4000 PSI, 80 RPM RECIPROCATING STRING.
03:00 - 06:00 3.00 ON SHORT TRIP PULLED 10 5/8" BIT FROM 5752 M TO 5330 M, FREE. FILLED EVERY 5 STANDS VOLUME OF STEEL EXTRACTED FROM WELL.
NOTE: BY REQUEST OF OPERATING UNIT, THREAD PROTECTORS NOT PLACED ON 5 7/8" XT-57 TP
06:00 - 08:00 2.00 WITH 10 5/8" PDC BIT AT 5,330 M, TESCO COMPANY CHANGED FACE AND RPM SENSOR OF TOP DRIVE ON DRILLER'S PARAMETER CONSOLE.
IN THE MEANTIME CIRCULATED WELL WITH BOTTLE TO DP WITH 25 SPM, 100 GPM AND 600 PSI.
08:00 - 12:00 4.00 RAN BIT FROM 5330 TO 5752 M (DRILLED DEPTH) FREE. FOR SAFETY RAN WITH ROTATION AND CIRCULATION LAST TWO STANDS WITH 110 RPM, 490 GPM, 3900 PSI.
12:00 - 00:00 12.00 DRILLED DIRECTIONALLY WITH 10 5/8" PDC BIT + PD + HTTA MWD + RHINO REAMER 12 1/4" FROM 5,752 TO 5765 M (REAMING TO 5737 M). WITH WOB: 6-10-17 TON, 130 RPM, 15,000-17,500 FT-LB, 500 GPM, 3854 PSI.
BIT RECORD: 365 M IN 177:25 HRS, 1.08 MPH, LAST 3 MTS: 85-68-22.
RHINO: 330 M IN 156:02 HRS.
* MUD VOLUME LOST TODAY: 0 M3.
* CUMULATIVE MUD VOLUME LOST STAGE: 527.4 M3.
**MAINTAINS IN CIRCULATING SYSTEM 15 KG/M3 OF CACO3 M-200 AND 2 LT/M3 OF VERSACOAT.
** FROM 5762 M PERFORMED DRILLABILITY TESTS TO OPTIMIZE ROP. VARYING PARAMETERS AS FOLLOWS: WOB 8-17 TON, RPM: 110-140, TQ: 15,000/17,500 FT-LB, 130 SPM, 500 GPM, 3854 PSI.

SACO PROBADOR A SUP Y CAMBIO X TAPON DE PRUEBAS CIA VETCO Y PROBO PREVENTOR ESFERICO 13-5/8"-10M CON 300PSI EN BAJA Y 7000PSI EN ALTA 40 MIN BIEN. HR. POR FALLA EN U. PRUEBAS. SE CONECTO PROBADOR DE COPAS CON EXTENSION E INTENTO PROBAR NUEVAMENTE S/E, SE OBSERVO QUE NO EMPACA COPA DE PRUEBA CIA PROPESA. SE SOLICITO OTRA COPA DE PRUEBA A CIA PROPESA, INSTALO COPA NUEVA E INTENTO PROBAR NUEVAMENTE S/E, LA COPA NO EMPACO. SE ESPERO TAPON DE PRUEBAS CIA VETCO Y SE INSTALO. AVANCE ACTUAL PRUEBA DE BOPSS 13-5/8"-10M CON 300PSI BAJA Y 8000PSI ALTA: 25%

06:00 - 10:00 4.00 WAITING FOR VETCO GREY COMPANY TO RECOVER WEAR BUSHING.
IN THE MEANTIME: PROPESA COMPANY PERSONNEL AND TEST UNIT TESTED CHOKE ASSEMBLY (VALVE X VALVE) WITH 300 PSI LOW AND 8000 PSI HIGH OK. IPC COMPANY PERSONNEL TESTED MUD PUMPS WITH NEW 5-1/2"X11" HYDRAULICS AND CHECKED ELECTRIC MOTOR NO. 1 OF MAIN DRAWWORKS.
10:00 - 11:00 1.00 WITH VETCO GRAY COMPANY PERSONNEL RECOVERED WEAR BUSHING.
11:00 - 00:00 13.00 WITH PROPESA COMPANY UNIT INSTALLED CUP TESTER, ATTEMPTED TO TEST 13-5/8"-10M BOPS REPEATEDLY WITHOUT SUCCESS. CHANGED CUP, ATTEMPTED TO TEST AGAIN WITHOUT SUCCESS. PULLED TESTER TO SURFACE AND CHANGED TO VETCO COMPANY TEST PLUG AND TESTED 13-5/8"-10M SPHERICAL PREVENTER WITH 300PSI LOW AND 7000PSI HIGH 40 MIN OK. 1 HR DUE TO TEST UNIT FAILURE. REPAIRED FAILURE IN HYDRAULIC FLUID HOSE. ATTEMPTED TO TEST UPPER RAM PREVENTER AND BLIND RAM OBSERVING LEAK IN TEST PLUG 'O' RING. CONNECTED CUP TESTER WITH EXTENSION AND ATTEMPTED TO TEST AGAIN WITHOUT SUCCESS, OBSERVED THAT PROPESA COMPANY TEST CUP DOES NOT PACK. REQUESTED ANOTHER TEST CUP FROM PROPESA COMPANY, INSTALLED NEW CUP AND ATTEMPTED TO TEST AGAIN WITHOUT SUCCESS, CUP DID NOT PACK. WAITED FOR VETCO COMPANY TEST PLUG AND INSTALLED. CURRENT PROGRESS OF 13-5/8"-10M BOPS TEST WITH 300PSI LOW AND 8000PSI HIGH: 25%
